aboutThisApp.title: About This App
aboutThisApp.description: What this app offers and how to study with it

whyScoringIsHardToLearn.title: Why Scoring Is Hard to Learn
whyScoringIsHardToLearn.description: Three reasons the author struggled to learn score calculation

whyScoringIsComplex.title: Why Scoring Is Complex
whyScoringIsComplex.description: The formula itself is simple; the hard part is the number of cases

manganKoRon.title: Non-Dealer Ron
manganKoRon.description: From 8,000 points for mangan, multiply by 1.5, 2, 3 and 4

manganOyaRon.title: Dealer Ron
manganOyaRon.description: From mangan up, 1.5 times the non-dealer ron score

manganKoTsumo.title: Non-Dealer Tsumo
manganKoTsumo.description: From mangan up, the dealer pays half of the non-dealer ron score and each non-dealer pays half of that

manganOyaTsumo.title: Dealer Tsumo
manganOyaTsumo.description: From mangan up, divide the dealer ron score by 3 and each of the three non-dealers pays that amount

jantouFu.title: Fu for the Pair
jantouFu.description: Only a pair of dragons, the round wind or the seat wind earns fu

mentsuFu.title: Fu for Sets
mentsuFu.description: Only triplets and quads earn fu, set by open or closed and by terminals and honors or simples

machiFu.title: Fu for the Wait
machiFu.description: Only closed, edge and single-tile waits earn 2 fu

tehaiFu.title: Fu for the Whole Hand
tehaiFu.description: Add up the six sources of fu and round up to the next 10

yaku.title: Counting Yaku and Han
yaku.description: Han is the total of yaku and dora; calling makes some yaku vanish or lose han

chiitoitsuScore.title: Scoring Chiitoitsu (Seven Pairs)
chiitoitsuScore.description: A special yaku fixed at 25 fu

pinfuScore.title: Scoring Pinfu
pinfuScore.description: 20 fu by tsumo, 30 fu by ron

menzenMentsuScore.title: Scoring Closed Hands Other Than Pinfu
menzenMentsuScore.description: Tsumo starts at 30 fu, ron at 40 fu

furoScore.title: Scoring Open Hands
furoScore.description: Only ron is 10 fu lower than for a closed hand

fuDoubling.title: Doubling the Fu Equals One More Han
fuDoubling.description: A pattern in the scoring table: 25 fu 2 han and 50 fu 1 han score the same

tsumoPayments.title: No Need to Memorize the Dealer Tsumo Column
tsumoPayments.description: A pattern in the scoring table: each payment on a dealer tsumo equals the dealer's share of a non-dealer tsumo

ronToTsumo.title: Halve the Non-Dealer Ron to Get Tsumo
ronToTsumo.description: A pattern in the scoring table: halving the non-dealer ron score twice gives the non-dealer tsumo payments

oyaRonScores.title: Memorizing Dealer Ron Scores Efficiently
oyaRonScores.description: A pattern in the scoring table: dealer ron is 1.5 times non-dealer ron, so memorize only the 14 cells that differ

index.pageDescription: Learn riichi mahjong scoring one step at a time with short lessons on fu, han, mangan and dealer and non-dealer payments. Take them in order.
index.allCompletedMessage: You have completed every lesson. Great work!

tenpaneExamples.yaochuMinkan: An open quad of terminals or honors (16 fu)
